title: Valid Anagram
description: Given two strings `s` and `t`, return `true` if `t` is an anagram of `s`, and `false` otherwise. An anagram is a word or phrase formed by rearranging the letters of a different word or phrase.

hints.content: If the lengths of s and t differ, they cannot be anagrams.
Count the frequency of each character in s and decrement for characters in t.
Use an array of size 26 or a Map to track character counts.

solution.explanation:
Frequency count using a hash map. Length mismatch early exit.
Time Complexity: O(n)
Space Complexity: O(1) (at most 26 lowercase English letters)
